evidence: Strict telemetry validation, model profiles, RFC 9457 errors, idempotency, and object history are implemented.
PostgreSQL transactions, per-robot advisory locks, unique event IDs, payload hashes, and stable ordering protect event state.
After-commit Redis caching has TTLs and database fallback; health probes, Prometheus metrics, resource limits, and a soak harness are provided.
Seven JVM tests plus API, idempotency, concurrency, ordering, Redis-failure, deterministic replay, and runtime checks run in CI.
Non-root read-only runtime, dropped capabilities, internal network, pinned images/actions, locked npm install, Trivy, dependency review, SBOM, and provenance are configured.
README and operations runbook document API examples, semantics, metrics, tests, failure handling, limits, and scope exclusions.
